recipes.description: a new recipe, ripe for a plump and savory definition.

categories.name: Meaty Members
categories.description: Everything built on flesh, egg, offal and gel.

categories.name: Produce Power
categories.description: Roots, leaves, pods and everything else pulled from the ground.

categories.name: Densecraft
categories.description: Grain, tuber, noodle and bread — the things that fill a plate.

categories.name: Fruition
categories.description: Sweet, sour and ripe, from the orchard and the vine.

categories.name: Dairy Air
categories.description: Milk taken as far as it will go: cream, butter, culture and cheese.

categories.name: Confection Convection
categories.description: Sugar, chocolate, jelly and everything that answers to them.

categories.name: Pantry Paradise
categories.description: The laneless staples — pressed oils and clean water.

categories.name: Bladesmithing
categories.description:
\C[1]Bladesmithing\C[0] is an ancient and very hot trade.
Literally, because anvils and hammers and shit are required to make your one and two handers, and dual-wielders.

categories.name: Spearcrafting
categories.description:
Ye olde \C[1]Spearcrafting\C[0] is a means to bond nature's long with sharp.
Crafting clubs, spears, and javelins will enable you to hunt at any distance.

categories.name: Gungineering
categories.description:
The amazing \C[1]Gungineering\C[0] is a stupendous means of making machines for war.
Not just any machines, in fact only pistols, shotguns, and tasers.

categories.name: Axeworkery
categories.description:
\C[1]Axeworkery\C[0] is the slapdash method of creating axes.
With practice, anyone can put out some impressive one or two handers, and eventually even a twin axe.

categories.name: Wandfusion
categories.description:
Legendary \C[1]Wandfusion\C[0] is the technomancy behind the creation of wands and the like.
The wizards and wizardesses of yore used to empower staves and wands, and even books nowadays to do the deeds.

categories.name: Fistmanship
categories.description:
The art of \C[1]Fistmanship\C[0] goes back as far as 178k years ago.
To master fistmanship is to master not just the fists, but the claws and the arms.

categories.name: Material Mastery
categories.description:
Mastery over materials is paramount in this land.
This will cover all your crafty needs regarding material refinement and processing.

categories.name: Material Manufacturing
categories.description:
Mastery over materials is paramount in this land.
Being able to refine ore into ingots and slice paper from lumber is crucial.

categories.name: Sole Defender
categories.description:
The craft of the \C[1]Sole Defender\C[0] creates unparalleled defensive armaments.
Outputs ranging from magical support relics to beefy kite shields, your defenses can be saved here.

categories.name: The Weaver
categories.description:
The deliberate hand of \C[1]The Weaver\C[0] is unmatched.
Producing both delicate mystical robes and enduring steel plate mail, your defenses shall be saved here.

categories.name: Fabulous Footwork
categories.description:
A light-hearted adventurer is he who started the \C[1]Fabulous Footwork\C[0] club.
Only those most dedicated to comfort and protection of the feet dare apply here.

categories.name: Accessorizing
categories.description:
The act of \C[1]Accessorizing\C[0] is known to few, and mastered by fewer.
The depths of which one can dive into this is varied, and magical, and also highly encouraged.

categories.name: Runic Creations
categories.description:
One who can create the runes can control the world- or so they say.
"Runes" are typically just enhancements for equips relating to optimizing combat potential.

categories.name: Gemology
categories.description:
The alchemy of gems is a wild science that many correlate with the Philosopher's Stone or
with turning shit into gold. How about turning shit into gems that give your stats a boost?

ingredientTypes.name: Crunch
ingredientTypes.description: Anything whose job is to be scattered over something soft.

ingredientTypes.name: Paste
ingredientTypes.description: Ingredients cooked down and worked smooth.

ingredientTypes.name: Sponge
ingredientTypes.description: Things whose job is to absorb whatever they are cooked in.

professions.name: Cooking
professions.description: Food and drink. Taught with Recipe Scraps, which anything at all may drop.

professions.name: Weaponcraft
professions.description: Everything you fight with, from blades to tomes to mecha arms. Taught with Blueprint Scraps, earned through offensive proficiency.

professions.name: Armorcraft
professions.description: Everything you wear. Taught with Pattern Scraps, earned through defensive proficiency.

professions.name: Alchemy
professions.description: Gems and runes. Its formulas are found in the world rather than taught, so it prices no tiers.

professions.name: Manufacturing
professions.description: The materials every other craft draws on. Its currency is undecided, so nothing here is charged yet.
